name: P804: a positional is added with dest and required, which argparse refuses
find: named = {} if not argument.flags[0].startswith("-") else {"dest": argument.dest, "required": argument.required}

name: P804: an argument with nargs "?" is an array in the input schema
find: many = argument.nargs not in (None, "?") or argument.repeats
replace: many = argument.nargs is not None or argument.repeats

name: P804: a run whose every check was skipped has no Finding, so check_all answers ok
find: return findings + (nothing if all(r["status"] == SKIPPED for r in results) else [])

name: P804: an ok check that holds unchecked notes has no could-not-run Finding
find: for r in results if r.get("unchecked") or r["status"] == COULD_NOT_RUN]
replace: for r in results if r["status"] == COULD_NOT_RUN]

name: P804: check-design reads a refusal as a run of the checks
P804: a stage that could not run has no Finding, so the build answers ok
find: for stage in stages if stage.status in (PROBLEMS, COULD_NOT_RUN)]
replace: for stage in stages if stage.status == PROBLEMS]

name: P804: a crash in the keep step leaves the work folder behind
find:
finally:
            if run.workdir is not None:

name: P804: the verdict's text ends with a second newline
P804: the kept entries' lines never reach stderr
find: diagnostics=list(run.diagnostics) + ["  %s" % entry["line"] for entry in kept or []]
